title: Financial Statements as Monitoring Mechanisms: Evidence from Small Commercial Loans

scopes.description: Reproduce the complete author-documented workflow and the supplementary analyses described in the only supplied package artifact. No executable entry point or complete workflow is supplied in this variant.

requirements.description: Compatible author-prepared analysis input(s) for the empirical analyses described in the appendix, including the Sageworks SLA loan and correspondence information or an equivalent prepared dataset. The precise supplied product, fields, sample coverage and preparation route are not specified.

routes.location: Sageworks SLA loan and correspondence data described in the appendix
routes.description: The appendix says the authors received proprietary SLA data in separate loan and correspondence files. No current access route or field-level compatibility is verified; the historical proprietary description does not establish that every route is blocked.

issues.description: The supplied variant contains only an online appendix PDF and no executable program, entry point, or run instructions. The paper describes manual document coding, but the supplied material does not disclose a complete replacement workflow.

The appendix gives summary descriptions of the historical proprietary loan and correspondence data, manual document categorization, results tables, and a state-level composite score, but it does not specify the complete input schemas, transformations, sample construction, software, sequencing, or which files/procedures produce each reported analysis. These are clarification leads; no separate mandatory raw-source requirements or analysis-only route can be established from this document-only variant.

actions.description: Obtain the complete author-supplied reproducibility package or an approved replacement description of the manual workflow, then map each main and supplementary output to its inputs and producing steps.
steps: Request the complete executable program set or an author-approved documented manual substitute, together with run instructions, required software and version details, and any execution logs.
Request a table-to-entry-point map covering the main-paper results and supplementary Tables B1–B8 and C1–C3 and Figure C1, including stage order and cross-file handoffs.
Request the exact analysis-input data dictionary, identifiers, sample coverage, transformations and preparation/coding steps, including the workflow that produces the reported results.

Request the operational source and construction specification for the Recovery Barrier measures, including whether the appendix tables are the complete supplied inputs or whether additional prepared data are required.

Request a compatible author-prepared analysis dataset or a documented permitted route for the SLA loan and correspondence inputs, including a data dictionary, sample coverage and any preparation needed; do not assume raw-source access is the only compatible route.
validation: Inventory the returned files and verify the documented stage order, all output-to-entry-point mappings, and the required inputs before assessing a runnable route.

review_notes: No analysis_only scope is created: this variant supplies neither executable analysis code nor compatible author-prepared analysis inputs. The dataset and source descriptions in the appendix are used only to guide the workflow clarification request.

Data are required for the described empirical target, but the only dataset route established by the appendix is an unverified historical proprietary-data reference; no absence of license or universal access barrier is inferred.
